osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried skewers, including a mentaiko-mayo bread skewer and mini buns (October 2026), with sauces, ponzu, sesame mustard and salt.
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The omakase mixes vegetable skewers (asparagus, taro, shiitake, tomato) with shrimp, crab, beef and eel; the shop asks about dislikes and allergies before the course (Tabelog; October 2026), but nothing is said about the batter or frying oil.
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00; closed Mondays; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: full at 17:00 on an October 2026 Sunday. Vegetable charge ¥330 per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 28 seats: a 12-seat counter on the 1st floor (smoking allowed), tables for 10 on the 2nd floor (non-smoking) and a private room for 3–5 (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.notes: [Kushiage · Shimanouchi, creative skewers until you say stop] A chic, dark-toned kushiage counter near Nagahoribashi where the omakase brings seasonal and playful skewers — mapo tofu in an edible basket, penguin-shaped bread, eel with ginger — alongside classics like angel shrimp and beef fillet, until you call stop. Staff suggest a sauce for each skewer and ask about dislikes and allergies first. Expect about 15 skewers and ¥4,000–7,000 a head. Book: it is full at opening at weekends. Smoking is allowed at the ground-floor counter; the upstairs tables are non-smoking.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 4 February 2020, later reopened after a renewal; creative kushiage using techniques honed at a long-established restaurant. Per tabiiro: the owner trained at well-known Osaka restaurants and fries in front of guests; a second shop opened in Umeda Nakazakicho in May 2024.

anecdotes.text: "I was surprised by the innovative idea of the mapo tofu skewer, where even the basket it came in was edible!" — October 2026, a 15-skewer course.
"The hospitality is exceptional" — August 2026, a reviewer noting that dislikes and allergies are carefully accommodated.
"While the flavors were delicious, I felt that the overall dishes could have used a bit less oil." — October 2026.

osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options but no detail. The steamed-vegetable sets come with salt ponzu, koji-yuzu mayo and bonito salt sauces (August 2026); udon, tempura and fries are also on the menu.
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options but no detail. The 12-vegetable steamer set came with bonito flakes and a bit of hamo (September 2026), and the dipping sauces include bonito salt, so ask for it without.
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.hours_raw: Tabelog gives daily 11:30–23:30 and, in its notes, Mon–Fri and Sat/holidays 11:30–23:00; open year-round. Lunch sets were still served after 16:00 on an August 2026 day. Reservations accepted, but not for café use; phone may be hard to reach at lunch (Tabelog). Menu and ordering, and payment, by smartphone (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR payment; no cover charge (Tabelog). 60 seats: low sofas, a 10-seat counter, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace with kotatsu in winter (Tabelog; 2024–2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). The entrance is easy to miss; staff let you in (2026).
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.notes: [Japanese dining bar · Hakuromachi, steamed-vegetable lunches on sofas] A greenery-filled dining bar a few minutes west of Midosuji, with low sofas, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace (kotatsu in winter). At lunch, order a bamboo steamer of a dozen vegetables or pork with three homemade sauces for about ¥1,300–1,700; at night, sashimi, hamo tempura and mentaiko udon with seasonal sake. Order and pay on your phone. Reviews in 2026 also mention dated cleanliness and an over-hot terrace in September.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member) and website sorairocolor.jp: a Japanese dining bar and café with seafood delivered daily, sake from around Japan and desserts made by a pastry chef.

anecdotes.text: "The entrance is a bit tricky, and you need to be noticed by the staff inside to get in." — September 2026, a fourth visit.
"The staff explained, 'You can enjoy the broth as a clear soup or pour it over rice like hitsumabushi'" — October 2026, the seafood yukke set.
"The cleanliness remains an issue, and the staff's friendliness was lacking as usual." — September 2026, a repeat visitor who otherwise liked the food.

osaka_avocado_house_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Plain avocado, avocado tacos, salsa and chips and guacamole are on the menu (September–October 2026), but nothing is described as vegan; many dishes use cheese, meat or fish.

osaka_avocado_house_namba.notes: [Mexican · Namba, avocado everything] A pink-fronted, mural-covered Mexican bar two minutes from Namba Station, where rich avocados go into almost every dish. Order the plain premium avocado (¥913), guacamole, a few tacos (¥495–605) and the chicken fajitas, flamed with tequila at the table; heat is mild, with six habanero sauces to add. The ¥4,000–5,000 courses bring three hours of drinks and unlimited tacos. Lively, with many international guests (September 2026); opens 15:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 5 November 2021; avocados chosen by oil content; "authentic cuisine that satisfies Mexicans".

anecdotes.text: "There were many international guests, and the lively ambiance made it feel like I was abroad!" — September 2026.
"The Chicken Fajitas ... are served sizzling on a teppan with spiced chicken and vegetables, flambéed with tequila right in front of you" — September 2026.

osaka_nikudokoro_kisshan_namba.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, butcher-run wagyu in Takashimaya] A wagyu yakiniku restaurant on the 8th-floor dining floor of Takashimaya at Namba, from a butcher-backed group (founded 1995). The lunch sets are the value: 150 g of kuroge wagyu and skirt with rice, soup and salad, or a cold-noodle and bibimbap half-and-half at ¥1,680. Dinner courses run ¥5,800–7,200; private rooms are popular and must be booked. Reviews in 2026 split between attentive service and a sukiyaki course where a nearly full room outran the staff (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): founded in 1995, backed by a butcher shop in Osaka for 50 years; this shop opened 2 March 2010. Per gurunavi, the group's main shop is 西中島総本店; a Tennoji shop is mentioned on Retty and by a September 2026 reviewer.

anecdotes.text: "... a basket to place my belongings in, and after I put my bag inside ... a cloth to cover it." — September 2026, Saturday noon, alone.

osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the gyoza filling is domestic black pork (Tabelog); braised pork, chicken and shrimp dumplings.

osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.notes: [Gyoza · Minamikata, bite-sized gyoza and a drink until 1:00] An 18-seat gyoza bar three minutes from Hankyu Minamikata, with a counter at the front and tables behind, where the gyoza are small enough to eat in one bite. Six pan-fried or boiled cost ¥430 (2026); a regular rates the light boiled ones best and the chilled gyoza as something new, and the table garlic oil is the house tip. Mapo tofu, braised pork and xiaolongbao round it out with beer and tea-shochu highballs. On several visits one person ran the whole place (2025–2026), and it suits a quick drink or a second stop after dinner. Open from 17:00 to 1:00 (Sundays to 23:00); cash only; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner-operator (unnamed); a regular calls the person running the shop "Yassan"
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a gyoza specialist with Chinese dishes and a drinks list; gyoza of domestic black pork and vegetables in thin skins sized for one bite; recommended to try them plain, then with garlic oil in the dipping sauce; two banquet courses with all-you-can-drink. Per reviews: "It was just Yassan running the place alone" (March 2026; also May 2025); "Even though it was a one-person operation, the service was surprisingly good" (August 2026); when a diner spilt chili oil on a white T-shirt, "the owner kindly handed me a towel with bleach on it" (May 2025); several diners found it quiet or empty early in the evening (2025–2026); a long-time regular counts 15 visits (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Bite-sized boiled and pan-fried gyoza with garlic oil; chilled gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "When you come to Gyoiiiiiin, you must start with the water dumplings!" — a regular on the 15th visit, March 2026.
"This dish breaks the concept that dumplings should be served hot." — May 2025, on the chilled gyoza.
"We dipped the gyoza in garlic oil and scooped some garlic with the folds for a bite. The flavor and aroma exploded." — June 2024.

osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broth of chicken bones and niboshi (June 2026), lard, thick pork chashu.
osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00, until sold out; closures not fixed (Tabelog). Tsukemen is served in the evening only, per a regular (April 2026). A diner was told the building is temporary and the air conditioning could go no lower (July 2026).
osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Sapporo-style grilled miso tossed over open flame] A 27-seat miso ramen specialist a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where flames leap from the pot as the chef tosses vegetables and lard before the miso goes in (2026). The Sapporo-style grilled miso (¥1,100) comes piping hot, richer-looking than it tastes, with homemade Hokkaido-flour noodles and thick chashu; regulars swear by the grilled shoyu with extra vegetables. Winter brings a black-garlic and cheese miso, November a Hiroshima lemon shoyu. The walls are covered in Orix baseball signatures and photos. Cash only; parking for three cars; tsukemen in the evening only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "The only Miso Ramen Specialty Shop in the ramen battleground of Nishinakajima"; celebrating its 10th anniversary; "The founder, who has thoroughly researched miso from all over Japan, has perfected the ultimate soup by adding unique twists to Hokkaido miso"; homemade noodles of Hokkaido flour blended with "Haru yo Koi". Per reviews: a diner says it "has been operating in this location for over 20 years" (April 2026) and another returned "after more than 10 years" (May 2026); signed memorabilia and photos of Orix players, especially Ryoma Nishikawa, cover the walls (2026); a regular on the 16th visit chats with the owner and staff (2025–2026); one diner could not hear the staff and had to ask three times which bowl was which (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Miso from all over Japan researched to make "the ultimate soup" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sapporo-style grilled miso ramen; grilled shoyu with vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "As I watched the flames rise higher than the chef’s face, I worried my fine hairs might get singed." — August 2026.

osaka_ryusho_higashiyodogawa.notes: [Ramen · JR Higashi-Yodogawa, seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen until 2 a.m.] A 16-seat tsukemen shop a minute from JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2014 and one of the few places to eat round the station until 2 a.m. The dip is a thick seafood-and-pork-bone broth made without back fat, full of diced chashu and sautéed onion, for thick, firm whole-wheat noodles; squeeze in the lemon halfway, and finish with soup to dilute the dip. Pork tsukemen is ¥1,000; the sweet and spicy tsukemen in four heat levels is the favourite (2026). Tickets from a cash machine at the door; PayPay too. Closed Wednesdays.

A small team (two chefs from northeast China and a server in July 2025) cooks Shanghai-style dishes adjusted for Japanese tastes; the room was once a French restaurant. The ¥5,000 course centres on Peking duck, with the leftover meat fried as kara-age; the ¥3,500 course is the value pick. À la carte runs to mapo tofu, sweet and sour pork and stir-fried bok choy. Round tables suit groups. Closed Wednesdays; lunch only by booking the day before.

osaka_chugokusai_oil_fukushima.notes: [Chinese · Fukushima, the mapo tofu people queue for] A seventeen-seat Sichuan restaurant in Fukushima, open since 2010 and on Tabelog's Chinese WEST 100 list four times, whose name is about oil, the heart of Chinese cooking. The draw is the mapo tofu: a ¥1,700 lunch set with glass-noodle salad, egg soup and free rice, and a queue of about twenty people at the 11:30 opening. Diners describe it as numbing and fragrant rather than fiery; one regular found it oilier and heavier than before, another more refined. Dinner is pricier (mapo and rice ¥2,900, a small beer ¥900) with shumai, shrimp mayo and seasonal specials. Cash only; no lunch bookings; you can buy the house chili oil.

Opened September 3, 2010.

osaka_grill_takeya_fukushima.notes: [Yakitori · Fukushima, the monthly booking battle] A ten-seat yakitori shop near the Sky Building, run by a couple and on Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 for 2024, where every seat for the next month goes by Instagram message around noon on the 20th. Almost everyone orders the bite-sized wagyu-fillet katsu sandwich, even as a second or third stop; there are also oysters, cheese, pasta and a beef stew. Diners in 2026 like the terrace, the seasonal pizzas and the desserts; one found the fettuccine came out so fast it might have been pre-made, and one thought a single pizza in a ¥3,000 course was thin for three. Orders are by QR code.

osaka_hakataro_hozenji.notes: [Izakaya · Hozenji, Kyushu food with private rooms] A Kyushu restaurant by Hozenji, opened in August 2017, with a counter on the ground floor and private rooms over four themed floors, used for business dinners, celebrations and quiet lunches. The menu travels the island: live Yobuko-style squid when it can be had, Kumamoto horse sashimi, Hakata motsunabe and mizutaki, Miyazaki chicken nanban and the Hakata ramen salad. An eight-visit regular notes the squid is often sold out, especially on holidays, and booking a day ahead helps. Weekday lunch sets can be booked for one. Diners in 2026 praise the calm rooms and the service.

osaka_reimenkan_shinsaibashi.notes: [Korean · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, handmade cold noodles since 2000] A Korean restaurant five minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, there since 2000, the Minami shop of a cold-noodle house whose main shop is in Ikuno-ku, where cold noodles are an everyday meal like udon. The handmade noodles are chewy in a light broth; diners in 2026 also order the samgyeopsal, chijimi, steamed pork, tail soup and hot pot, and praise the kimchi served alongside. Portions are made for sharing. A regular of 20 years calls everything delicious and cheap; a September 2026 diner who knows the Kitashinchi branch felt less satisfied here. Closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog menu, the main shop is in Ikuno-ku, an area with many Korean residents of Japan, where cold noodles are as casual a choice as udon or okonomiyaki; usually eaten to finish a yakiniku meal, so the house created a place to enjoy a bowl of cold noodles on its own. Per Tabelog, the Shinsaibashi shop has been in Minami for 26 years (opened 18 April 2000) and promoted Korean food long before the recent Korean wave.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A place where you can casually enjoy a bowl of cold noodles" (Tabelog menu).

osaka_kokyo_yoniku_kushi_shimanouchi.notes: [Chinese · Shimanouchi, Yanji-style lamb skewers] A Northeast-Chinese restaurant near the Dotonbori River, run on the lamb cooking of Yanji in Jilin, where the owner grew up: small cubes of mutton dusted with chili, sesame and cumin and grilled over charcoal at your table, ¥220 a skewer in September 2026. Regulars come back for the skewers with Qingdao beer, the di san xian of eggplant, pepper and potato and the boiled dumplings; portions are big and made for groups. A January 2026 diner found all the floor staff were from China and the flavours like a trip there; a March diner was sometimes unsure of being understood in Japanese. The street around it has Chinese shops and a Chinese grocery across the road. Pay by cash or PayPay; no cards.

osaka_takoyaki_juhachiban_nishinakajima.notes: [Takoyaki · Nishinakajima, tenkasu-packed takoyaki since 1990] The 1990 main shop of Juhachiban, right by the Hankyu Minamikata gate: takoyaki at the front window and a small room behind with counter, two tables and drinks. The balls are full of tenkasu, so they come out crisp outside and creamy inside, with octopus, pickled ginger and small shrimp in a batter of dashi and milk (September 2026). Try the "Ohashiko" assortment: salt, sauce and tendashi or ponzu, 12 pieces for ¥950, or all four flavours for ¥1,270 (September 2026). Bonito flakes, aonori and mayonnaise are free on the table. A favourite late stop for locals after a drink. Cash or PayPay only; smoking allowed.

A September 2026 diner writes that the shop "was established with the desire to create a takoyaki shop where girls can casually drop by" under the motto "One Ball, One Soul". Another September 2026 diner was shown in by an older woman grilling takoyaki at the front, and writes that the brand has since opened other shops, including Dotonbori and Universal Studios Japan.

osaka_kissa_alterna_shinmachi.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 17:00–23:00, closed Wednesdays, while its shop text says open daily 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30, last entry 21:30) and closed on the last day of consecutive holidays; the official site gives 17:00–24:00 (last orders 23:00 and 23:30) and irregular closures. Reservations; the seat type may change on the day (Tabelog). A ¥550 appetizer charge (Tabelog; ¥500 in September 2026). Mobile ordering (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 24 seats: 14 at a counter around the open kitchen and 10 at tables (Tabelog; 22 on the official site); smoking outside only; English-speaking staff; children by arrangement, no child cutlery (Tabelog). Opened 17 June 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_kissa_alterna_shinmachi.notes: [Izakaya · Shinmachi, creative plates and soba behind a hieroglyph sign] A dim, stylish back-street izakaya in Shinmachi, run by a soba company and marked by a hieroglyphic sign, with most seats at a counter around the open kitchen and hip-hop on the stereo. The draw is the shimi-ton, a juicy rare pork cutlet over soft egg drowned in sauce, along with Miracle Ebi Mayo, rare salmon cutlet and fig with prosciutto and white miso, all in small, pretty portions. Finish with soba, such as cold soba under natural-yam foam. Diners in 2026 were almost all delighted; one wished for more dishes. The shop takes no allergy requests. Evenings only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a directly run shop of the Sobayoshi (そばよし) group, "restaurant × bar × soba", marked by "the world's only existing hieroglyphics" on its sign. Per Tabelog: opened 17 June 2023; the specialty is the shimi-ton, a twist on Osaka's tonpei-yaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Shimi-ton pork cutlet; soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "One of my favorite aspects of this place is the opportunity to enjoy soba at the end of the meal." — September 2026, a second visit, cold soba with natural-yam foam.
"The crispy fried pork cutlet is generously coated with sauce and fluffy eggs, making it a perfect pairing with drinks." — September 2026, the shimi-ton.
"One downside was the limited food options, which was disappointing." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sobayoshi.com): 喫酒オルタナ、グループ直営店、世界で唯一現存する象形文字が目印、レストラン×酒場×蕎麦、17:00〜00:00 (料理 L.O.23:00、ドリンク L.O.23:30)、不定休、西区新町1-8-10 横山ビル1F、22席、分煙 (屋外に喫煙スペース)、四ツ橋駅・西大橋駅から徒歩5分。食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・そば・創作料理、17:00〜23:00、水曜休み (店の紹介では毎日17:00〜23:00、連休最終日休み)、予約可、お通し550円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、24席 (カウンター14、テーブル10)、英語を話すスタッフ、アレルギーには対応しない (同じ厨房・器具でコンタミの可能性)、2023年6月17日オープン、名物の Shimi-ton、クラフトジン、オリジナルカクテル。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Shimi-ton 2,000円、Miracle Ebi Mayo 1,000円、カルパッチョ1,100円、レアサーモンカツ、いちじくと生ハムの白味噌、締めの蕎麦 (自然薯の泡の冷たい蕎麦、すだち蕎麦、担々蕎麦)、モバイルオーダー、料理の種類が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); mobile ordering (September 2026).

staff_allergy_handling: The shop does not accommodate allergy requests; all dishes are made in one kitchen with shared dishes and utensils, so cross-contamination is possible; ask by phone before visiting about changes to a meal (Tabelog).

osaka_tachigui_sakaba_kinjishi_shinsaiba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, marinated mackerel and seared wagyu are where to start; the fried horse mackerel, demi-katsu, shumai, yakisoba, ramen and baguette are wheat-based.
osaka_tachigui_sakaba_kinjishi_shinsaiba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, pork, chicken and fish; a mitsuba namul (September 2026) is the only vegetable dish described.
osaka_tachigui_sakaba_kinjishi_shinsaiba.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; closed 1 January (Tabelog). Lunch set meals at midday, with a cheaper draft beer with lunch and free rice refills (September–October 2026). A ¥500 set of a drink and three small snacks (September 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 40 places: a counter, high tables and standing room, a little cramped (Tabelog; August and October 2026); non-smoking, smoking area nearby; free Wi-Fi; takeaway; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 18 March 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_tachigui_sakaba_kinjishi_shinsaiba.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi PARCO, a standing bar open from 11:00] A standing bar (with high stools) in the B2F food street of Shinsaibashi PARCO, the third shop of Kinjishi, with a daily-changing board of fish and meat and the owner's choice of local sake. It opens at 11:00, so lunch sets from ¥880 (salt yakisoba with shumai, fried horse mackerel with pickle tartar) turn into daytime drinking; try the ¥100 marinated mackerel, seared wagyu with egg yolk or a ¥500 drink-and-three-snacks set. Diners in 2026 praise the value and some dishes; others found it cramped, the portions small, the ramen too salty or some staff off-putting. Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the third Kinjishi, with an upgraded menu alongside the signature dishes, a daily-changing menu and the owner's selection of local sake; open from 11:00 for daytime drinking; opened 18 March 2021. A June 2026 diner compares it with the Sakaisuji Honmachi shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish and wagyu small plates with sake.

anecdotes.text: "Then I found the 500 yen set! You get your choice of drink and three types of snacks!" — September 2026, before a movie.
"The marinated mackerel was an incredible bargain at just 100 yen." — October 2026.
"However, the ramen itself is disappointing... It has a strong salty flavor, which overshadows the taste of the dashi." — October 2026, the chuka soba set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 立喰酒場 金獅子 心斎橋パルコ店 (たちぐいさかば きんじし)、居酒屋・焼肉・海鮮、心斎橋筋1-8-3 心斎橋パルコ B2F、Shinsaibashi 駅から徒歩30秒、毎日11:00〜23:00、1月1日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、40席、カウンター、立ち飲み、禁煙 (近くに喫煙所)、無料Wi-Fi、テイクアウト、子ども可、2021年3月18日オープン、3号店、日替わりのメニュー、店主が選ぶ地酒、11時から昼飲み。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 500円のドリンクとおつまみ3品のセット、いちじくバターのバゲット、びわと生ハム、肉寿司、和牛、ネギトロ、豚タン、しめ鯖100円、和牛の炙りと卵黄、ランチ880円から (Super Ebi Soba と焼売、柴漬けタルタルのアジフライ)、デミカツ、ポークステーキ、中華そばの定食、狭い、量が少ない、ラーメンが塩辛いという声。

osaka_kushikatsu_hyotan_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried kushikatsu, plus crispy fried gyoza and tonpei-yaki.
osaka_kushikatsu_hyotan_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushikatsu of beef, pork, chicken, shrimp and fish alongside the vegetable skewers, with doteyaki and gyoza; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_kushikatsu_hyotan_honten.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–24:00, last order 23:00; open year-round; set meals at lunch only, 11:30–16:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 per person (Tabelog). Payment: Tabelog lists cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money, no QR payment; an August 2026 reviewer at a mid-afternoon lunch was told cash only — ask. 140 seats with a counter and enclosed private rooms for 2 to 30; heated tobacco only in a designated area, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Strollers fit inside (October 2026). Water on request (August 2026). Takeaway takoyaki temporarily suspended (Tabelog).
osaka_kushikatsu_hyotan_honten.notes: [Kushikatsu · Sennichimae, a big, lively skewer house behind NGK] A 140-seat kushikatsu and teppan izakaya just behind the Yoshimoto theatre, open from 11:30 to midnight every day, with a counter and plenty of enclosed private rooms. Order a mix of skewers with the misuji gyukatsu, the tonpei-yaki and the crispy gyoza; at lunch there are sets of nine skewers or a ¥720 dashimaki set. Reviewers praise the light batter; order in small batches so the skewers stay hot. Card payment is listed, but one 2026 lunch visitor was told cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 6 April 2015; kushikatsu with batter and frying oil developed through the shop's own research.
chef_bio.specialty: Misuji gyukatsu; tonpei-yaki; crispy fried gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "I visited during holiday lunchtime after going to the Yoshimoto Theater. The restaurant has plenty of seating, so I was able to get in right away." — September 2026.
"All the freshly fried Kushi Katsu arrived at once. If you want to enjoy them hot, it might be better to order in smaller batches." — September 2026.
"Just a heads up, ... only accept cash for payment." — August 2026, lunch after 15:00 (Tabelog lists cards).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 串かつ ひょうたん 本店、串揚げ・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、大阪市中央区難波千日前11-25 はつせビル 1F、NGK の裏、Namba Walk の B21出口・Nannan Town の E5出口から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、年中無休、定食は昼のみ (11:30〜16:00)、予約可、チャージ300円、カード・電子マネー可、QR 決済不可、140席、個室 (2〜30名)、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、2015年4月6日オープン。衣と揚げ油にこだわった串かつ、みすじの牛肉のカツ、カレー風味のチューリップ、とんぺい焼き、手作りのパリパリ焼き餃子、50種以上のドリンク、15品のコース3,500円、飲み放題つき5,000円。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 串かつ9本のランチ、だし巻き定食720円 (税抜)、1,000円以下のランチ、どて焼き、ししゃも、種を取ったきゅうり、無料のキャベツ、衣が軽い、まとめて出てくるので少しずつ注文を、現金のみと言われたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Large, lively and easy to walk into; private rooms. A gurunavi-sourced listing mentions English (search result, 2026-11-02), not confirmed on Tabelog.

osaka_momoju_namba_komejirushi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: monjayaki and okonomiyaki are wheat-flour batters, and yakisoba is wheat noodles.
osaka_momoju_namba_komejirushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the monjayaki base is a Western-style stock of chicken bones, onion, celery and red wine (Tabelog shop text), and okonomiyaki comes with bonito flakes (May 2026).
osaka_momoju_namba_komejirushi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last food order 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (last food order 21:30); closed irregularly once or twice a month, see Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations: Tabelog says not accepted, while reviewers booked in May and July 2026 — ask. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR payment (Tabelog). 40 seats: 4 at the counter, 36 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Seats by the entrance get hot in summer (July 2026). Okonomiyaki takes about 30 minutes (August 2026).
osaka_momoju_namba_komejirushi.notes: [Monjayaki · Namba CITY, Osaka-style monja cooked for you] A monjayaki and okonomiyaki shop in the Namba Komejirushi food street under Nankai Namba, branch of a long-running Osaka monja house whose batter uses a Western-style chicken and vegetable stock. Staff cook the monja at your table — try the mentaiko special (¥1,980) and finish with the crispy edges; okonomiyaki and yakisoba arrive cooked. English menu and English-speaking staff. Expect queues at weekend lunch; okonomiyaki takes about 30 minutes.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a long-established Osaka-style monjayaki restaurant loved by Kansai locals. An August 2026 reviewer says the main shop is in Nagai; aumo (search result) mentions a Grand Front Osaka shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Osaka-style monjayaki with a Western-style stock.

anecdotes.text: "This time, I found myself nearby at an early hour, so I checked for reservations and was able to secure one perfectly!" — May 2026, after eyeing it for 3–4 years past long lines.
"I had forgotten how to eat it, so the staff kindly showed me." — July 2026, a second try at monjayaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 百十 なんばこめじるし店、もんじゃ焼き・お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、大阪市浪速区難波中2-10-25 なんばCITY なんばこめじるし、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (料理 L.O. 14:00)、17:00〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、不定休 (月1〜2回、Instagram で案内)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、40席 (カウンター4、テーブル36)、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語を話すスタッフ。鶏ガラ、玉ねぎ、セロリ、赤ワインの洋風だしの大阪らしいもんじゃ、お茶漬けも。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): もんじゃは店の人が焼いてくれる、明太スペシャル1,980円、カレー、ねぎすじカレー、ふわふわのお好み焼き、すじのお好み焼き、豚焼きそば1,100円、海鮮焼きそば1,440円、とんぺい、山芋の柚子、昼は単品のみ、本店は Nagai、予約して行ったという声、お好み焼きは30分ほどかかる。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); staff cook the monjayaki and show you how to eat it (2026).

osaka_niku_bar_gam_namba_honten.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steaks and meat sashimi come with sauces, ajillo with baguette, and courses include onion fries and wagyu tendon stew.
osaka_niku_bar_gam_namba_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a red-meat bar; the free salad that comes with a steak order is the main vegetable dish.
osaka_niku_bar_gam_namba_honten.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–25:00 (last order 24:00); Sun and the last day of long holidays 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer had sukiyaki here at lunch. Reservations accepted online until 22:00 on the day, three groups a day; pairs may be seated at the counter (Tabelog). Appetiser ¥440 (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink of 200 drinks: ¥1,000 for two hours (January 2026), ¥1,500 (May 2026); the minimum food order has changed over time — three dishes per person (March 2026), one steak per person (June 2026), two dishes per person (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 60 seats over the 2nd and 3rd floors; the 3rd floor can be booked privately (up to 30); smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_niku_bar_gam_namba_honten.notes: [Meat bar · Namba, steaks with free salad and cheap drinks] A late-opening meat bar on two floors behind the old Namba Kabukiza, serving red-meat steaks, meat sashimi and meat sushi, with a free salad when you order a steak. The draw is the 200-drink all-you-can-drink, ¥1,000–1,500 for two hours in 2026, but it now comes with a minimum food order. Portions are small, so order several plates. Smoking is allowed; many foreign guests (October 2026). Book: online slots are limited.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 1 September 2015, floors renewed October 2021. A second shop, お初天神店 in Umeda, opened in September 2018 (ikyu, search result).

anecdotes.text: "For the all-you-can-drink option, you now have to order one steak per person, and the prices have really gone up" — June 2026, a regular.
"I was surprised by the small size of the meat dishes. They were truly just bite-sized!" — April 2026.
"It was almost fully booked, with many foreign guests as well." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉バルGAM 難波本店、肉バル・ステーキ、大阪市中央区難波4-6-3 南進ビル 2F、なんば駅12番出口から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 24:00)、日・連休最終日17:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、予約可 (ネット予約は当日22時まで、1日3組)、お通し440円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、60席、3階は貸切可 (30名まで)、喫煙可、2015年9月1日オープン。赤身と希少部位、牡蠣と肉、肉寿司、ステーキを頼むとサラダが無料、200種の飲み放題つきのコース。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): 飲み放題は1,000円 (2026年1月)、1,500円 (2026年5月)、条件は1人3品 (3月)、1人ステーキ1枚 (6月)、1人2品 (10月)、肉寿司、Top blade の刺身、Niku-ra、馬刺し、マッシュルームとオイルサーディン、たたき、量は少なめ、昼はすき焼き (2026年5月)、外国人客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many foreign guests (October 2026); smoking allowed. No English evidence found.

osaka_choyokaku_nagahori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The set meals pair stir-fries with an egg-and-sauce dish, kara-age, shrimp tempura and gyoza; dandan noodles and ramen are wheat noodles.
osaka_choyokaku_nagahori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chinese set-meal restaurant built on pork, chicken, shrimp and egg dishes; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_choyokaku_nagahori.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:30; closed irregularly with the building (Tabelog). Set meals served through the afternoon, still after 16:00 (October 2026); pan-fried gyoza not served at lunch (August 2026). Reservations accepted; drink plans from ¥3,500 bookable on the day (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, nanaco, WAON and iD; no QR payment (Tabelog). 44 seats, semi-private table for up to 12; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Busy at weekday noon, quieter after 12:30 (September 2026).
osaka_choyokaku_nagahori.notes: [Chinese · Crysta Nagahori, set meals and three dandan noodles] A long-running Chinese restaurant in the Crysta Nagahori underground mall, with set meals mostly under ¥1,000 served all afternoon. Order a dandan noodle — white (sesame and miso), black or red (numbing and spicy) — or the kara-age set with its egg-and-sauce dish to pour over the rice. In the evening a beer, gyoza and kara-age set is ¥1,290. Busy at noon; quieter after 12:30.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): in the Crysta Nagahori gourmet zone; 44 seats. An August 2026 reviewer heard it has been a long-standing Chinese restaurant for decades. Another shop, パナンテ天満橋店, appears on autoreserve; one October 2026 review on this listing describes a visit to a shop at Keihan Tenmabashi.
chef_bio.specialty: Three dandan noodles (white, black, red); set meals.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose from three types of gyoza and five or six types of kara-age. The draft beer is a proper size" — August 2026, the ¥1,290 quick drink set.

osaka_soba_makino_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the soba is served with a bonito-based tsuyu; tempura of shrimp and vegetables.

osaka_soba_makino_fukushima.notes: [Soba · Fukushima, a Soba 100 house] A sixteen-seat soba house in a quiet street between Fukushima and Osaka stations, on Tabelog's Soba 100 list four times, with a queue before the 11:30 opening. The soba is ground in house, 100% buckwheat by diners' accounts: try the thick, flat, grey-brown inaka soba first with just salt, then the dipping sauce, and finish with the thick soba-yu; the shrimp tempura zaru (¥1,950) is the favourite. Evenings are calmer, for sake with small snacks before the soba. Closed Wednesdays; pay by PayPay.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: soba of house-milled buckwheat, firm and chewy; side dishes and about ten sakes at night; a warm wooden room; Tabelog Soba 100 in 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025.

"The soba is made with 100% buckwheat and has a wonderfully smooth texture." — October 2026, a regular's tempura soba.

osaka_panyo_kitashinchi.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, steak by the gram] A black-themed teppanyaki room in a Kitashinchi basement, open since 2021, with a counter and a VIP private room. Order wagyu by weight, or take the nine-dish ¥13,800 course: meat sushi topped with Hokkaido sea urchin, a mini burger, lobster and fillet steak, then garlic rice or the black curry (¥999 extra). The ¥6,600 trial course and the lunch steak from ¥2,980 are the cheaper ways in. Diners praise the flambé and the manager's service; one found the private-room fee a surprise (March 2026). 10% service; e-cigarettes allowed at every seat.

osaka_yakitori_the_dojima.notes: [Yakitori · Dojima, a Kozaka-chicken omakase] A nine-seat yakitori counter on a second floor in Dojima, open since 2024, that grills only Kozaka chicken from Kyotanba, aged for days, over charcoal. The ¥13,800 omakase moves from a thigh tataki and side dishes such as shumai through neck, heart and liver to a finish of ramen, chicken soba or clay-pot rice; there is no chicken sashimi, by design. A September 2026 diner calls it the high-end shop of the Goichi yakitori group. Reservation only; diners praise the friendly head chef, though one in October 2026 wanted more surprise for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an omakase of rare Kozaka chicken from Kyotanba with seasonal ingredients, slowly charcoal-grilled, nine counter seats; opened 13 March 2024. A September 2026 diner calls it "a high-end version of the Goichi Group"; another met the same griller and owner earlier at "Ryoubou"; a July 2026 diner writes that the grillers came from the former "Bird Oka" in Nakameguro.

anecdotes.text: "The ramen and mapo tofu served as a finale were of such high quality that they could stand alone as a restaurant offering." — August 2026.
"For the first time, even the liver tasted good to me!" — July 2026.
"…the chicken soba was especially tasty." — October 2026, with clay-pot rice to finish.
